_note: Which teams the /teams/ page shows, in order, with their sub-team labels. Membership is NOT here: it is curated by hand in teams-membership.json (team, optional sub-team, agent ids). Group chats are never required; hintGroups maps a still-existing group chat (by its agent id) to a team/sub-team, and sync-teams.js only uses it to SUGGEST where an uncurated agent may belong. A missing group chat never removes anyone. Private teams (health, private life) are not public teams and must not be added here.
